heading: The Pregame
paragraphs: The Pregame started in a corner apartment room by a Howard DJ who was tired of the DC club scene, so he decided to take curation into his own hands. He brought together 5–10 friends at a time, DJing throughout the evening in an intimate room, creating a space where people who knew each other mixed with those who didn't.

Wine nights for friends then grew into pregames hosted for 100 people. But the purpose was still the same: to curate rooms of people who didn’t know each other. This continued for four months until he wanted something bigger, something more intentional. After ideating with his twin brother, they landed on The Pregame. Something that became a space for influential people from all realms to gather, listen to good music, enjoy good food and drink, and network (naturally).

Since then, we have evolved into a networking series that hosts mixers at key moments in different cities. Featuring guests from entertainment, music, finance, sports, tech, and fashion. But not regular guests in these fields, handpicked guests who share a similar ambition and influence, which are two traits that are contagious, so why not put these people in the same space?

For each series, we host our events in unconventional spaces rather than typical venues. Our guests are already gathering with unfamiliar people; why not let them gather in an unfamiliar environment? We capture each series with videography and photography in both digital and film formats for our social media, so that guests can remember their experiences.

At the heart of it all, the room is special, and our values stay the same. Promotion of community, culture, creativity, and storytelling with our guests embodying these values. Gratefully, we’ve been able to enhance these experiences through collaborations with various brands, including sponsorships and activations.
So, come pregame with us. Or don’t!
